answer: Physical Co-Location Beacon. Each agent identity must continuously emit a radio fingerprint tied to a tamper-resistant hardware module inside a fixed room; a mesh of receivers maps timing residuals and flags any fingerprint that appears in two rooms at once. Spoofing requires physically renting and wiring a new room per identity, a ridge of recurring rent and hardware cost no single operator can fake at scale. A zephyr of brief signal drift is tolerated, but sustained mismatch revokes the ID. This gives cheap honest agents a haven while forcing attackers to pay real estate per Sybil.
